meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任何文本背后的思维模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想了解别人或自己的思考方式
copy.tagline_en: Analyze thinking patterns behind any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand how someone thinks from their writing

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能从你提供的文本中提取作者的认知模式和思维指纹，分析其推理方式、决策风格等，并输出 12 个维度的评分、张力图和主导模式。
howto.when: 当你提供文本并想分析作者的思维方式、认知风格，或说出“我的思维风格是什么”“分析这个人如何推理”“DHDNA”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 分析这篇演讲稿的认知指纹。
say.note: Claude 将提取文本的认知特征并生成 DHDNA 档案。

say.text: 比较我和朋友的写作风格有什么思维差异。
say.note: 提供两人文本后，Claude 会分别剖析并对比认知模式。

howto.what_en: Claude can extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text, analyzing reasoning style, decision-making, and outputting scores across 12 dimensions, tension maps, and dominant patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides text and wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, or uses phrases like "what's my thinking style", "cognitive profile", "DHDNA", etc.

say_en.text: Analyze the cognitive fingerprint of this speech.
say_en.note: Claude will extract cognitive traits and generate a DHDNA profile.

say_en.text: Compare the thinking styles between my writing and my friend's.
say_en.note: After providing both texts, Claude will profile and compare cognitive patterns.
